parameters.query:
SELECT
  m.id                        AS membership_id,
  m.plan_name,
  m.policy_template,
  m.monthly_rate,
  m.status,
  m.start_date::text          AS start_date,
  m.end_date::text            AS end_date,
  m.notice_period_days,
  m.notes,
  m.created_at::text          AS created_at,
  c.id                        AS customer_id,
  c.full_name                 AS customer_name,
  c.email,
  c.phone,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
        'id',            r.id,
        'room_id',       r.room_id,
        'room_name',     rm.name,
        'day_of_week',   r.day_of_week,
        'start_time',    r.start_time::text,
        'end_time',      r.end_time::text,
        'rate_per_session', r.rate_per_session,
        'frequency',     COALESCE(r.frequency, 'weekly'),
        'end_date',      r.end_date::text,
        'active',        r.active
      ) ORDER BY r.day_of_week, r.start_time)
      FROM bookings.recurring_rules r
      LEFT JOIN bookings.rooms rm ON rm.id = r.room_id
      WHERE r.membership_id = m.id
    ), '[]'::json
  )                           AS rules,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT SUM(mi.balance_due)
     FROM bookings.membership_invoices mi
     WHERE mi.membership_id = m.id AND mi.status NOT IN ('paid','waived')
    ), 0
  )                           AS total_balance_due
FROM bookings.memberships m
JOIN bookings.customers c ON c.id = m.customer_id
WHERE m.tenant_id = $1
ORDER BY m.status, c.full_name;
